description: This file provides a storage service interface for interacting with Supabase storage, including functionalities such as file upload, retrieval of public URLs, creating signed URLs, file removal, and listing files. It includes validation and error handling mechanisms to ensure safe and proper usage.

methods.name: ensureClient()
methods.description: Checks if the Supabase client is initialized; returns an error shape if not.

methods.name: validatePath(bucket, path)
methods.description: Validates bucket and path strings to prevent unsafe file paths.

methods.name: uploadFile(bucket, path, file, options = {})
methods.description: Uploads a file to a specified bucket and path with options for content type, upsert, and cache control.

methods.name: getPublicUrl(bucket, path)
methods.description: Generates a public URL for a specified file in a bucket.

methods.name: createSignedUrl(bucket, path, expiresIn = 3600)
methods.description: Creates a signed URL for private access, valid for a specified duration.

methods.name: removeFiles(bucket, paths)
methods.description: Deletes multiple files from a specified bucket.

methods.name: listFiles(bucket, folderPath = '', options = {})
methods.description: Lists files in a bucket, with optional filtering by folder path and pagination options.
